components.label: Moving Averages (SMA/EMA) — Fast, low complexity; ideal for streaming data and simple trend tracking.
Savitzky-Golay Filter — Preserves signal shape, peak heights, and widths using local polynomial fits.
Gaussian Filter — Smooths out high-frequency noise evenly using a symmetric Gaussian kernel.
Kalman Filter — Optimal for real-time state estimation with noisy multi-sensor or dynamic system inputs.
LOWESS / LOESS — Non-parametric regression; robust against strong outliers in offline datasets.

dataModel.section_0_points:
• Access current data point: Retrieves value at index `i` from input array.
• Accumulate sum: Adds current value to running `windowSum`.
• Eject old value: If index `i >= windowSize`, subtracts the value at `i - windowSize` to maintain fixed window size.
• Calculate and store: Once `i >= windowSize - 1`, divides `windowSum` by `windowSize` and appends result to output array.
dataModel.section_1_points:
• Access current data point: Retrieves value at index `i` from input array.
• Set initial seed: If `i === 0`, pushes the first value directly into result array as baseline.
• Fetch previous EMA: Reads `ema[i - 1]` from result array for previous step's value.
• Apply smoothing weight: Calculates weighted result using formula `(val - prevEma) * multiplier + prevEma`.
• Store result: Appends calculated EMA value to output array for use in next iteration.
